shared_elements: large circular/disc motif set centrally on a broad panel
schematic carved motifs arranged above the disc
justification: The only real correspondence is that each surface carries a prominent circular emblem — a plain ring with flanking crescents on A, a multi-armed whirl/spiral rosette on B — placed in the middle of a broad panel with smaller motifs above it, which is a generic scheme any carving tradition could reach independently. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a monumental anthropomorphic figure with a carved head and body-borne curvilinear insignia, while B is a flat bordered panel bearing schematic quadruped/animal figures alongside the spiral, with no human form at all.
